content.title: How to watch River v Boca in the Torneo Apertura
content.text: La Número 12·18 April 2026How to watch River v Boca in the Torneo AperturaFind out how and where to watch the Superclásico of Argentine football between River Plate and Boca Juniors this Sunday at the Monumental stadium for the 2026 Torneo Apertura. The match will have dual TV coverage and will also be available via streaming. The team led by Claudio Úbeda visits Eduardo Coudet’s River this Sunday starting at 5 p.m. in a new edition of the country’s biggest derby. Both teams come into it in good form, unbeaten in 12 matches for the Xeneize and 9 for the Núñez side.OneFootball VideosThis clash, which brings the country to a standstill, will be broadcast on both channels included in the Fútbol Pack: it can be watched on TNT Sports Premium and also on ESPN Premium. To watch it, you need to have the pack subscribed through any of the cable providers available in Argentina.Boca visit River at the Monumental in a new edition of the Superclásico.The match can also be watched live via streaming: TNT Sports can be subscribed to through Telecentro (without a TV plan) and currently costs $17,182 (Argentine pesos). This service can also be purchased through Claro if you have a mobile or fiber-optic internet plan: it costs $16,000. To watch the ESPN option, it is available through any cable provider or on Disney+ Premium, a plan that costs around $20,000 and can also be purchased through other services such as Meli+ or mobile phone companies.To watch the clash between the Xeneize and the Millonario on television, you can tune into channels 112 and 1018 on Telecentro. On DirecTV, it is available on 603 and 1603. On Claro TV, meanwhile, it is on channel 121 and channel 250 on Movistar TV.In addition, the Superclásico can be followed on Boca’s Channel with live commentary and analysis. As always, the minute-by-minute coverage of the match will be on La Número 12 with exclusive content from the Monumental, live stats, and the best information.
